about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling adventure in Walking on Ice, a game where quick thinking and strategic moves are your best allies. Test your brainpower as you guide your character across icy terrains to reach the level exit. But there’s a twist—on the slippery ice, you’ll slide continuously in one direction until you hit a barrier. Can you solve the puzzle and escape the frozen maze?

Challenging Ice Puzzles to Keep You Hooked

Each level is a unique puzzle, crafted to test your logic and planning. Glide across the ice, but beware of tricky obstacles like breakable tiles, movable blocks, teleporters, and more. As you progress, the puzzles grow more intricate, providing hours of stimulating gameplay for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

Key Features:

  • Hundreds of Levels: Enjoy a wide variety of ice-themed puzzles, from simple mazes to complex challenges.

  • Dynamic Obstacles: Conquer frozen floors, dodge hazards, and use creative solutions to clear each stage.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple swipe controls make it easy for anyone to play, but only true strategists will conquer all the puzzles.

  • Offline Gameplay: Take on icy challenges anytime, anywhere—no internet connection needed!

Perfect for Puzzle Lovers

Walking on Ice is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers, sliding puzzles, or games that challenge your problem-solving skills. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for fun or a puzzle expert seeking your next challenge, this game has something for everyone.

Step into the frosty adventure and show your skills in navigating the icy mazes. Solve puzzles, outsmart obstacles, and reach the exit in record time. Are you ready to conquer the frozen terrain?
